1.

Product Overview

A durable, space-efficient door system for commercial, industrial and residential openings — engineered around the opening, not the other way round.

Rolling Shutters are durable and space-efficient door systems designed to provide security, controlled access and protection for commercial, industrial and residential openings.

The shutter curtain rolls vertically into a compact coil above the opening, making the system suitable for locations where floor and side space is limited.

They can be manufactured in different materials, profiles, finishes and operating configurations according to the application and project requirements — suited to shops, warehouses, factories, commercial buildings, garages, industrial facilities and service areas.

Security

Provides a strong physical barrier and controlled access.

Space Saving

Vertical rolling operation requires minimal floor space.

Durability

Suitable materials can provide reliable long-term performance.

Custom Design

Available in different sizes, profiles, materials and finishes.

Easy Operation

Manual and motorized configurations are available.

Automation

Can be integrated with access control and automation systems.

2.

Rolling Shutter Types

Pick the curtain type that matches the opening — from a shop shutter to a high-security industrial bay.

＋ Manual

Manual Rolling Shutters

Operated using a hand chain, spring mechanism or other manual arrangement. Suited to shops, small warehouses, commercial premises, service areas and smaller industrial openings.

＋ Motorized

Motorized Rolling Shutters

Use an electric motor for convenient opening and closing — operated by push buttons, remote controls or integrated control systems.

＋ Industrial

Industrial Rolling Shutters

Designed for larger openings and demanding industrial environments, with heavy-duty components selected to project requirements.

＋ Perforated

Perforated Rolling Shutters

Security with visibility and ventilation through the curtain. Suited to shopping centres, retail stores, showrooms and parking areas.

＋ Vision

Transparent / Vision Shutters

Visibility through the shutter while maintaining controlled access and security — ideal where product visibility matters.

＋ High Security

High Security Shutters

Enhanced physical protection with stronger profiles, reinforced components and locking arrangements matched to the required security level.
